situation (example wording): "Officers per 1,000 population in Salem, Oregon since 1960" (a staffing rate at a base other than 100,000)
what the app does today: Answered per 100,000, Crime Index's published base, with a line saying it was not per 1,000 (PR #132's first draft).
proposed behavior: A rate asked at another base (per 1,000, per 10,000) is given at that base: Crime Index's published rate per 100,000 converted (divided by 100 for per 1,000), its decimals kept. The column is labeled with the asked base, and one line says the figures are derived from Crime Index's published rate per 100,000.
exact default or choices offered: The asked base; per 100,000 when none is named.
why: People ask officers per 1,000; the published figure answers it exactly once the base is converted, and the line keeps the source plain.
test cases: Tests that cite this row: scripts/test-nibrs-historical.ts.
